step1_analysis.description: An active mixer circuit used for frequency down-conversion in a direct-conversion receiver. Due to the grounded gate on one of the RF transconductance transistors (M2), it operates as a single-balanced mixer, multiplying the RF input with the differential LO to produce a differential IF/baseband output.

paper_reference.title: RF Front-End of Direct Conversion Receiver RFIC for CDMA-2000

Conversion Gain.description: Ratio of the intermediate frequency (IF) output voltage amplitude to the RF input voltage amplitude.

paper_reported.technology: Unknown (likely BiCMOS or CMOS given 2.7V supply)

sky130_expected.calculation: With Itail = 0.15mA, gm1 = 2.3mA/V. Conversion gm = gm1 * 2/pi = 1.46mA/V. With Rload = 5kOhm, Gain = 1.46m * 5k = 7.3 V/V = 17.2 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply and chosen load resistors to ensure stacked transistors remain in saturation.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the circuit from the supply.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the bias point required to keep the stacked transistors in saturation under 1.8V.

Operating Frequency.description: The RF and LO frequencies the mixer is designed to operate at.

sky130_expected.calculation: Set RF to 2.001 GHz and LO to 2.000 GHz to produce a 1 MHz IF for simulation.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the CDMA-2000 bands reported in the paper.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power and transient conversion gain of the mixer.
step3_testbench.spice:
* RF Front-End Mixer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param R_load=5k
.param R_tail=1k
.param W_rf=10u L_rf=0.15u
.param W_lo=10u L_lo=0.15u

* Modified DUT: Changed Q to M and npn to sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 to use SKY130 MOSFETs
R1 V1 VDD {R_load}
R2 V2 VDD {R_load}
R3 E3 GND {R_tail}
M1 E1 IN1 E3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_rf} L={L_rf}
M2 E2 GND E3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_rf} L={L_rf}
M3 V1 IN+ E1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_lo} L={L_lo}
M4 V2 IN- E1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_lo} L={L_lo}
M5 V1 IN- E2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_lo} L={L_lo}
M6 V2 IN+ E2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W={W_lo} L={L_lo}

VGND GND 0 0

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* RF input at 2.001 GHz, 10mV amplitude
VIN1 IN1 0 DC 0.7 SIN(0.7 0.01 2.001G 0 0)
* Differential LO at 2.000 GHz, 300mV amplitude
VINp IN+ 0 DC 1.2 SIN(1.2 0.3 2.000G 0 0)
VINn IN- 0 DC 1.2 SIN(1.2 0.3 2.000G 0 180)

B1 out_diff 0 V=v(V1)-v(V2)

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(V1) v(V2) v(E1) v(E3)

* Transient analysis to capture 1MHz IF (1us period)
tran 10p 3u
meas tran vout_max max v(out_diff) from=2u to=3u
meas tran vout_min min v(out_diff) from=2u to=3u
let vout_pp = vout_max - vout_min
let vout_amp = vout_pp / 2
let gain_linear = vout_amp / 0.01
let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_linear)
print gain_db
quit
.endc
